**Authorized use and review**

Named authorizer/date; permitted scope; expiry; reauthorization after tool, risk, role or performance change.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Set demonstration criteria before the assessment. Attendance alone is not verified competence. An operator stays within the approved task and operating tiers. Include reviewer capacity and competence in staffing decisions.
